auth.adminsOnlyHint: You need an administrator account to manage this server.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or was moved.

login.setupSubtitle: {{server}} asks everyone for a code from an authenticator app after their password. It takes a minute.
login.codeHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.recoveryHint: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned it on. Each works once.

setup.title: Welcome to Pley
setup.subtitle: Create the administrator account for this server.
setup.passwordHint: At least {{min}} characters. A few words that don't go together are easy to remember and hard to guess.
setup.setupCodeHint: Open Pley from its tray icon and it's filled in for you. On a server without one, it's in Pley's log (with Docker, run docker logs pley).

setupServer.title: Your server
setupServer.subtitle: Pley will use these. Change any that's wrong; each is in Settings afterwards.
setupServer.name: Server name
setupServer.nameHint: Apps and devices list the server by it.
setupServer.languageHint: The default for everyone, and for devices in a language Pley doesn't have. Each person can choose their own.
setupServer.keyNeeded: Needed for movie posters and summaries.
setupServer.tmdbHint: With a key, TV shows come from TMDB too, in the language of titles and summaries. Get a free API key
setupServer.keyRefused: TMDB didn't take this key. Check it, or continue without it.
setupServer.bonjourHint: iPhones, iPads, Macs and Apple TVs on your network find it by themselves. Without it, they need its address.

setupStart.title: How would you like to start?
setupStart.fromPlexHint: Libraries, profiles, watch history, collections and playlists.

setupLibrary.title: Your libraries
setupLibrary.subtitle: Show Pley the folders your movies, shows and music are in. Each starts scanning as soon as it's added.

invite.codesSubtitle: Your account is ready, and two-step sign-in is on.
invite.setupSubtitle: Your account is made. {{server}} asks everyone for a code from an authenticator app after their password.
invite.cantBeUsedHint: The link is wrong, has expired, or has already been used. Ask the person who sent it for a new one.
invite.signOutFirst: To create a new account with this invitation, sign out first.
invite.createToWatch: Create your account to start watching.
invite.createToWatchExpires: Create your account to start watching. This invitation expires {{when}}.

twoStepSetup.qrLabel: QR code that adds Pley to an authenticator app
twoStepSetup.stepAddOnPhone: Add Pley to an authenticator app on this phone.
twoStepSetup.stepScan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
twoStepSetup.stepEnterCode: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows for Pley.
twoStepSetup.appsHint: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, Bitwarden and most password managers work.
twoStepSetup.keyOnPhone: No app on this phone? Scan the QR code below with another device, or enter this key:
twoStepSetup.keyInstead: Can't scan it? Enter this key in the app instead:
twoStepSetup.codesIntro: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe, like a password manager. If you lose your phone, each one signs in once instead of a code from the app. They won't be shown again.

twoStep.title: Two-step sign-in
twoStep.intro: After your password, Pley asks for a code from an authenticator app on your phone, so a password alone can't sign in to your account.
twoStep.onSince: On since {{date}}: signing in takes your password and a code from your authenticator app.
twoStep.required: This server requires it, so it stays on.
twoStep.noCodesLeft: No recovery codes left: make new ones, so a lost phone doesn't lock you out.
twoStep.fewCodesLeft_one: Only {{count}} recovery code left: make new ones before they run out.
twoStep.fewCodesLeft_other: Only {{count}} recovery codes left: make new ones before they run out.
twoStep.codesLeft_one: {{count}} recovery code left, for when your phone isn't at hand.
twoStep.codesLeft_other: {{count}} recovery codes left, for when your phone isn't at hand.
twoStep.useAnotherAppHint: For a new phone, or another authenticator app
twoStep.noteOn: Devices already signed in stay signed in. Sign out any you don't know under Devices.
twoStep.noteMoved: Codes from your old authenticator app, and your old recovery codes, don't work any more.
twoStep.needApp: You'll need an authenticator app on your phone, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password or Bitwarden.
twoStep.moveHint: For a new phone or another authenticator app. Until you enter a code from the new one, the current one keeps working.
twoStep.newCodesHint: New recovery codes replace the ones you have: those stop working.
twoStep.movedToast: Two-step sign-in uses your new app
twoStep.turnOffHint: Turning it off takes your password and a code from the app, or a recovery code.

profile.notAPicture: Choose a picture (JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF).
profile.tooBig: Pictures must be smaller than 10 MB.
profile.colorFallback: Shown when your picture can't be.

playback.title: Audio and subtitles
playback.intro: Used until you pick tracks for a title. Your picks are remembered for each title.
playback.subtitleLanguageHint: Choose the language you read: without one, only forced subtitles come on.

off.label: Off
off.hint: Subtitles stay off until you turn them on.

forced.label: Only for foreign dialogue
forced.hint: Only forced subtitles, for signs and foreign dialogue.

foreign.label: When the audio is in another language
foreign.hint: Full subtitles come on when the audio isn't in your subtitle language.

always.label: Always
always.hint: Subtitles in your language come on whenever there are some.

pin.title: Profile PIN
pin.managedHasPin: This profile is protected by a PIN. Ask an administrator to change it.
pin.managedNoPin: This profile has no PIN. Ask an administrator to change it.
pin.badPin: The PIN must be 4 to 8 digits.
pin.protected: Your profile is protected: others in your home need this PIN to switch to it.
pin.unprotected: Protect your profile so others in your home can't switch to it without a PIN.

password.title: Change password
password.noPassword: This account has no password: an administrator can give it one.

history.title: Watch history
history.empty: Movies, episodes and songs you finish show up here.

devices.title: Devices
devices.signedOutOthers: Signed out on your other devices

apps.title: Apps
apps.none: No apps use your account. Apps ask on a Pley page before they get access.

tokens.title: Tokens for other apps
tokens.subtitle: Plex or Jellyfin compatible
tokens.name: Name
tokens.nameHint: The app or tool it's for.
tokens.onlyFromHint: Addresses or networks, such as 192.168.1.20 or 10.0.0.0/24. Leave empty for anywhere.
tokens.copyNow: Copy the token for <bold>{{name}}</bold> now. It won't be shown again.

consent.title: {{app}} wants to use your Pley account
consent.callsItself: It calls itself “{{name}}” (Pley can't check that name)
consent.notOwn: This app isn't one of Pley's own

scopes.library: See {{profile}}'s libraries, playlists and watch history.
scopes.play: Play titles, and keep {{profile}}'s place, watched marks, ratings, track choices and library order.
scopes.profiles: Switch to the household's other profiles. Profiles with a PIN still ask for it.
scopes.requests: Ask for movies and shows the libraries don't have, and follow {{profile}}'s requests.
scopes.approvals: Approve and decline what people ask for, where the account is an administrator.
scopes.activity: See what's playing and stop it: {{profile}}'s streams.
scopes.activityEveryone: See what's playing and stop it: {{profile}}'s streams, and everyone's where the account is an administrator.

consent.cantChange: It can't change your password, sign-in settings or devices.
consent.cantChangeNoAdmin: It can't change your password, sign-in settings or devices, and it never gets administrator rights.
consent.rightsOnly: Of your administrator rights it gets only {{rights}}: the others stay in Pley's web app.
consent.adminStays: Your administrator rights stay in Pley's web app.
consent.overTv: This request is over: start again on your TV
consent.overApp: This request is over: start again from the app
consent.onlyIfOnScreen: Only allow this if that code is on a screen in front of you right now. Never use a code someone sent you.
consent.onlyIfStarted: Only allow this if you just started signing in to the app.

authorize.cantSignIn: This app can't sign in here
authorize.backGoesTo: Back to the app goes to:

link.title: Sign in on your TV
link.signingIn: {{app}} on your TV is signing in
link.checkCode: Check that your TV shows this code, then continue.
link.enterCode: Enter the code your TV shows.
link.strayLetter: Codes don't use A, E, I, O, U or Y: check the code on your TV.

home.title: Home
home.noLibrariesAdmin: Point Pley at the folders where your movies, shows and music live. It will scan them and build your library.
home.noLibrariesUser: Ask the server owner to add a library.
home.scanningHint: New items will show up here as soon as they're found.
home.emptyHint: Your libraries are empty. Add media to the library folders and run a scan.

library.noMatchesHint: Nothing in this library matches the current filters.
library.emptyHint: Pley didn't find any media yet. Check the library folders, then scan again.
library.nothingToRecommendHint: Recommendations appear once the library has some items.

profiles.title: Who's watching?
profiles.mustSetUp: This server requires two-step sign-in, which {{name}} hasn't set up yet. Enter the profile's password to set it up now.
profiles.seesMore: This profile can see more than yours.
profiles.enterPasswordAndCode: Enter its password and the code from its authenticator app to switch.
profiles.setUpHint: {{name}} will sign in with a code from an authenticator app after the password, from now on.
profiles.locked: {{name}} can see more than your profile: an administrator can give it a PIN to switch to it.

saveFilters.title: Save these filters
saveFilters.describe: {{filters}}. It keeps up with the library by itself.

playlist.label: Smart playlist
playlist.hint: Yours: plays what these filters find.

collection.label: Smart collection
collection.hint: Everyone's: shown with the library's collections.

search.nothingThere: Nothing there either. Try a different spelling or a shorter query.
search.emptyHint: Find movies, shows, episodes, people, artists, albums, tracks and Live TV channels. Press / anywhere to jump to the search box.
search.differentSpelling: Try a different spelling or a shorter query.
